get.summary: Returns the occupancy rates for the given facilities
get.description: Returns the occupancy rates of the selected facilities in the selected range of days, averaged for each one-hour interval. Select facilities by providing at least one locationId or objectId. Omitting both parameters will yield an empty result.

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: The UUID of the location to return the occupancy for. Multiple values may be specified by providing the parameter multiple times.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The UUID of the object to return the occupancy for. Multiple values may be specified by providing the parameter multiple times.

parameters.name: periodStartDate
parameters.description: The start date (inclusive) of the period for which to return the occupancy. The date must be specified in ISO 8601 full-date format, e.g. 2016-09-01

parameters.name: periodEndDate
parameters.description: The end date (inclusive) of the period for which to return the occupancy. The date must be specified in ISO 8601 full-date format, e.g. 2016-09-01

parameters.name: timeStart
parameters.description: The start time of the day for which to return the occupancy. The time must be specified in 24-hour `H:mm` time format, e.g. 8:30 or 13:00. Default value is 0:00.

parameters.name: timeEnd
parameters.description: The end time of the day for which to return the occupancy. The time must be specified in 24-hour `H:mm` time format, e.g. 8:30 or 13:00. To specify the end of the day, use 24:00. Default value is 24:00.

parameters.name: timeZone
parameters.description: The time zone in which the occupancy should be calculated. The time zone must be specified according to the name in the IANA Time Zone Database, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam

parameters.name: weekDay
parameters.description: The day of the week for which the occupancy should be calculated.

get.description: Only available for operators, for persons use /requester/reservations instead.

parameters.name: $fields
parameters.description: Only include these specific fields in the response. Fields of sub-entities are separated with a dot

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: The amount of reservations to show. Maximum 10000.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
A FIQL search expression to filter the result. The query parameters from earlier versions still work, but if this parameter is provided, all other filter parameters are ignored. The FIQL query syntax is documented in the tutorial.

The fields available for filtering are:
  • status, archived, number, briefDescription, notes, numberOfPersons, plannedStartDate, plannedEndDate
  • requester (id, email, loginName, networkLoginName, employeeNumber)
  • reservedForOther (id, email, loginName, networkLoginName, employeeNumber)
  • operatorGroup (id, name)
  • operator (id, name)
  • event (id, number)
  • processingStatus (id, name)
  • series (id)
  • reservedFacilities.location (id, roomNumber)
  • reservedFacilities.object (id, name)
  • reservedFacilities.asset (id, name)
  • reservedFacilities.reservedServices (id, serviceId, operatorId, supplierId)
  • participants.persons (id, email, loginName, networkLoginName, employeeNumber)
  • participants.visitors (id, number)
  • optionalFields1, optionalFields2 (all sub-fields)
  • externalLinks (id, type, date)

200.description: The full list of reservations matching the search criteria. The list is ordered by plannedStartDate

206.description: The amount of matches was larger than could be shown. Further results can be obtained by requesting reservations with a later plannedStartDate

Specified services will be added to the facility in addition to standard services. All services will be reserved with the default values from the service card. post.summary: Make reservation recurrent on specific dates
post.description:
Make a reservation or request recurrent using the 'specific dates' pattern. Reservations with services on facilities can be made recurrent this way, but those with separately reserved services cannot. Neither can reservations with issued facilities.

The dates must be unique, and after the original reservation. The original occurence date can be included and will be ignored. The series cannot have more than 999 occurrences in total.

The dates should be specified in the ISO 8601 date only format (yyyy-MM-dd).

The returned list will include all reservations in the new series, including the existing ones. Only the fields id, number, status, series, plannedStartDate and plannedEndDate will be included.

Note that the recurrent reservation overview emails will not be sent, even if the setting has been enabled.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: The identifier or number of the reservation

parameters.name: allowConflicts
parameters.description: If false, this endpoint will return a bad request with details if the request would create conflicts. Only when this parameter is explicitly set to true, conflicting occurrences can be created.

post.summary: Add occurrences to a reservation that is recurrent on specific dates
post.description:
Add occurrences to a reservation series using the 'specific dates' pattern. Reservations with services on facilities can be added to this way, but those with separately reserved services cannot. Neither can reservations with issued facilities.

The dates must be unique, and after the specified reservation. Any specified dates where an occurrence already exists, will be ignored. The series cannot have more than 999 occurrences in total.

The dates should be specified in the ISO 8601 date only format (yyyy-MM-dd).

The returned list will include all reservations in the new series, including the existing ones. Only the fields id, number, status, series, plannedStartDate and plannedEndDate will be included.

Note that the recurrent reservation overview emails will not be sent, even if the setting has been enabled.

put.summary: Set occurrences for a reservation that is recurrent on specific dates
put.description:
Set occurrences for a reservation series using the 'specific dates' pattern. Reservations with services on facilities can be modified this way, but those with separately reserved services cannot. Neither can reservations with issued facilities.

The dates must be unique, and after the specified reservation. Occurrences before the specified reservation will always be kept, occurrences after it will be deleted if not included in the body. The series cannot have more than 999 occurrences in total.

The dates should be specified in the ISO 8601 date only format (yyyy-MM-dd).

The returned list will include all reservations in the new series, including the existing ones. Only the fields id, number, status, series, plannedStartDate and plannedEndDate will be included.

Note that the recurrent reservation overview emails will not be sent, even if the setting has been enabled.
